recipe.visualDefinition: A complex, surrealist composition featuring multiple overlapping figures and silhouettes of Black individuals amidst a swirling, cosmic background of vibrant, saturated colors. The style blends fine-art portraiture with abstract, airbrushed textures and sharp, high-contrast silhouettes that emerge from a dark, nebulous void.
coreVisualRelationships: Interplay between detailed figurative painting and flat, dark silhouettes.
Fluid, organic transitions between warm skin tones and cool, cosmic blues/purples.
Dynamic movement created by swirling fabric-like shapes and reaching limbs.
coreInvariants: Deep black negative space used for silhouette profiles.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Multiple focal points; a central dancing figure on the left and a serene portrait on the right, balanced by smaller silhouettes in the periphery.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright, warm-toned central figure and the white headscarf of the right-hand portrait.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: A circular flow following the curves of the bodies and the swirling background clouds, moving from the top left down through the center and up to the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy use of deep black and dark indigo to define edges and create depth.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black and dark indigo provide the structural foundation.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant yellow, orange, and white highlight the primary subjects.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Magenta, cyan, and lime green appear in the nebulous background clouds.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme high saturation in the highlights against a low-value, dark background.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid flat, solid fills without texture

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavyweight, wide-set sans-serif with decorative flares.
letterConstructionRules: Small, sharp triangular serifs or flares at terminals
characterSpecificRedesigns: Horizontal bars are thick and consistent
Terminals have a slight outward kick
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used across the top for unity.

candidateDirections.reason: Similar flared terminals and bold presence.
Shared sharp flares and classic 70s feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a surrealist oil painting with airbrushed textures featuring multiple overlapping Black figures and silhouettes. Use a palette of deep black, vibrant yellow, orange, magenta, and cyan. Include a central dancing figure and a portrait with a white headscarf. The background should look like a cosmic nebula.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, wide, yellow uppercase text with flared terminals across the top edge. The text should be tightly spaced and justified to the left and right margins.

verificationChecks: Is the text bright yellow and top-aligned?
Are there distinct silhouettes emerging from the dark background?
Does the color palette include high-saturation psychedelic swirls?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subjects
Exact placement of the small white pearls/dots
The specific signature in the bottom right
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text has the characteristic 70s flared terminals.
Check that the silhouettes are integrated into the background clouds.
Verify the presence of a grainy, canvas-like texture.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine surrealist figurative oil painting with cosmic airbrushing and high-contrast silhouettes, topped with bold, flared-terminal display typography in a vibrant primary color.
